newsitem.title: USA: Clinton has 62 percent approval rating in poll.
newsitem.headline: Clinton has 62 percent approval rating in poll.

text.p: A new poll released Saturday showed President Clinton's popularity remaining high in the early days of his second term.
The Time magazine-CNN survey found that 62 percent of Americans surveyed approved of the way Clinton was handling his job as president. Other polls have produced similar results.

The Time-CNN poll was taken by telephone Wednesday and Thursday, just after Clinton's State of the Union address Tuesday night. It surveyed 1,012 Americans 18 years of age or older. It had a sampling error of plus or minus 3 percent.
Improving education led the list of what those questioned thought should be Clinton's top priority. It was named by 34 percent.
